description: This file implements a command for retrieving and filtering log lines from a log file, with options for channel filtering, line limits, and JSON output. It includes functions for reading the tail of a log file, parsing log lines, filtering by channel, and outputting results.

methods.name: parseChannelFilter
methods.description: Parses the raw channel string input, normalizes it, and checks if it exists in the set of known channel plugins, defaulting to 'all'.

methods.name: matchesChannel
methods.description: Determines if a log line matches the specified channel based on subsystem or module inclusion.

methods.name: readTailLines
methods.description: Reads the last lines from a log file, handling large files efficiently by reading only the tail segment.
